method: Scores (0-10) combine perspective breadth, severity wording, cross-source corroboration and momentum. They measure attention and concern in public reporting - not probability, not a forecast. Read the sources before acting.
summary: Scanned 420 items from 12 of 13 sources; 76 matched a perspective and were grouped into 73 distinct issues.
Top list ratings: Elevated 10 (10 threats, 0 watch items).
Momentum baseline still building (1 of 3 days collected).
